test_title: PYST 6: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:
"A person who dislikes human beings ___."
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Misanthrope**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Misanthrope"** refers to a person who dislikes and avoids human society. (मनुष्य जाति से घृणा करने वाला व्यक्ति) • **Example:** The old man was a misanthrope who lived alone in the mountains, far from human contact. • The correct word here is **"Misanthrope"**, as it directly refers to someone who harbors a dislike for humanity. (मनुष्य जाति से घृणा करने वाला व्यक्ति) • **Example:** After years of betrayal and disappointment, he turned into a complete misanthrope and avoided social interactions. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Misanthrope**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Philanthropist** (परोपकारी): A person who seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially by donating money to good causes. • **Example:** The billionaire is a well-known philanthropist who has donated millions to charity. • **Extrovert** (बहिर्मुखी): A person who is outgoing and enjoys being around people. • **Example:** She is an extrovert who thrives in social gatherings and loves meeting new people. • **Optimist** (आशावादी): A person who has a positive outlook and expects good things to happen. • **Example:** Despite the challenges, she remains an optimist and believes everything will turn out fine. 43:T11ca, सही उत्तर है: **विकल्प 2 अर्थात् मानवद्वेषी**।
